fields.value: A paused run parks each order's macro before its next line; a wait under way runs out. ▶ resumes it.

fields.name: runs
fields.label: Runs
fields.none: No run of this side is live

fields.value: A stopped run is over: its orders are yours again, and no new ones are taken.

fields.name: session
fields.label: Record what you do by hand on

fields.value: Follows the orders you send from now on: New, Replace and Cancel on Sent Orders, and DK on Received Trades.
Follows the orders that arrive from now on: Accept, Reject, Fill, Unsol Cxl and Restate on Received Orders, and Correct, Bust and Re-notify on Sent Trades.
Each action will run the moment what it answered comes. Time is written only where nothing came between two of your actions.
Each action will also wait the time you took to answer — a venue with a person's pauses.
The macro opens in ${row.Side} Macros. If the name is taken the recording goes on; if nothing was recorded, nothing is saved.

options.label: (a file on the server: give its path below)
iso-timestamped — Three client messages with ISO-8601 timestamps
order-flow — Six order messages, one direction, no header
pipe-raw — Three client messages, pipe-delimited, no timestamp prefix
soh-raw — Three client messages, SOH-delimited, no timestamp prefix
two-sided-day — A day between a client and a venue, both directions

fields.name: file_path
fields.label: File path on the server
fields.placeholder: /path/to/fix.log — ignored when an example is picked

fields.value: The whole file is read once: its CompID pairs, message types and time span become the job's summary. Raw SOH or pipe lines, QuickFIX and ISO-timestamped logs are recognised; logons, heartbeats and the other admin messages are left out.

fields.name: msg_filter
fields.label: Message types to replay
fields.none: The file holds no application messages

fields.value: Speed scales the gaps between the log's timestamps; a gap longer than the maximum is cut to it (a lunch break, the overnight). The window is by the log's time of day.

enable.when: ALL(rows, r -> not CONTAINS(['running', 'paused'], r.status) and r.target_session != '' and r.session_status == 'ACTIVE')

fields.name: direction
fields.label: Direction (the log's sender → target to play)

fields.value: Sent as ${row.target_session}: its CompIDs, sequence numbers, SendingTime and TransactTime replace the log's; every other tag goes out as logged, routing tags and repeating groups included. Types: ${row.msg_filter}.
